summary: Q2 closed with a semiconductor melt-up (XSD +5.24%, AMD +7.68%, KLAC +8.38%) capping the chip sector's best quarter ever, while NVDA lagged. Capital rotated out of crypto (CRCL -17.55%, MSTR -6.20%) and AI-infrastructure REITs/power (DLR -5.77%, CEG -4.22%) into silicon. Oil posted its largest quarterly drop in 6 years as Iran de-escalated.
